_comment: Coco's subtitles in ja, de, fr, es, zh and ko, keyed by the English line in lines.json (which companion_voice.py rewrites; this file it never touches). The voice stays English; the subtitle follows the player's language. Checked by ops/nutaku/fold_f2p/check_i18n.py.
